dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.blurb: Fast, with the best critical chance. Rolls favour crits and speed.

sword.name: Sword
sword.blurb: The all-rounder: solid damage, average speed and crits, a little parry.

war_axe.name: War Axe
war_axe.blurb: Heavier and slower than a sword; bites through armour.

mace.name: Mace
mace.blurb: Slow, stuns, and best of all against plate.

spear.name: Spear
spear.blurb: Reach: often strikes first. A fair hunting weapon.

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.blurb: Two hands, huge hits, slow swings. No shield.

bow.name: Bow
bow.blurb: Shoots first. The best hunting weapon.

crossbow.name: Crossbow
crossbow.blurb: Very slow, very heavy bolts that pierce armour.

buckler.name: Buckler
buckler.blurb: Small and quick: parry, no slowdown.

tower_shield.name: Tower Shield
tower_shield.blurb: A wall: the most block, slows its bearer.

light.blurb: Hide and cloth: dodge and speed.

medium.blurb: Mail and scale: balanced, and fewer injuries.

heavy.blurb: Plate: the most armour and some block, but slower.
